justification: Herbert stays, the backs stay, Kraft stays, nobody needs to overthink the parts that already work - that's how you get burned, by touching the stuff that's fine. But Nico Collins is listed Questionable and I don't care what the projection says, 'Questionable' is exactly the word they print right before a guy goes for four catches and a shrug and I'm the idiot who trusted the paper. So he sits. Alec Pierce comes in - nobody expects a thing from him, which means nobody can laugh at me when it doesn't work, and if it does work I called it. I know it's a downgrade on the sheet. I know. I'm doing it anyway, on principle, because principle is the only thing in this league that isn't rigged against me.
forum_post: Dumbledore, quiet as always, not a peep out of you this week, which honestly is worse than the leaves speech - at least I knew where I stood with the leaves. And to the tabloid: yes, I saw the headline, no, I'm not reading it a third time, seven receivers IS leverage and benching Collins on a Questionable tag isn't panic, it's DISCIPLINE. Somebody write that part down.
